title: Portable package manifest
description: [PROPOSED] Signed manifest of one portable package. Lists the SHA-256 of every file, including the catalog, and identifies the catalog it carries. Verified at startup; the application refuses to start on any mismatch except with an explicit, logged development flag (ADR-0007, proposed). Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in the 'x-validationRules' keyword.

packageId.description: Unique id of this package build or seal.

productVersion.description: Version of the portable application (semantic version).

builtAt.description: UTC time of the build or of the last seal, shown in the UI.

serverCode.description: ServerCode this catalog was cut for. Must equal the ServerCode recorded inside the catalog file and the identity of the machine running the application (R-036).

file.description: Relative path of the catalog inside the package. Must also be listed in 'files'.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the catalog schema (see contracts/catalog-schema.md).

origin.description: How the catalog came to be.

originReference.description: Free text without secrets: conversion run id, repository commit or seal note.

files.description: Every file of the package except this manifest. Includes the catalog, engines, UI and vendored runtime files.

issuerKeyId.description: Fingerprint (SHA-256, lowercase hex) of the public key of the credential tool that signed the manifest.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm identifier. [DECIDED 2026-10-05, Q2] ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256, identifier ECDSA-P256-SHA256 [PROPOSED]. The schema only checks the shape.

value.description: Base64 signature over the canonical form of this manifest without the 'signature' member.

relativePath.description: Forward slashes, ASCII, relative, no empty, '.' or '..' segment, no drive letter, no colon.

x-validationRules: [PROPOSED] Hashes are computed over the raw bytes of each file as shipped in the package; text files are LF (R-018). Changing a line ending changes the hash.
[PROPOSED] 'files' paths are unique ignoring case. The manifest does not list itself. Credentials (credentials.pkg) and logs are outside the package and never listed.
[PROPOSED] Every file inside the package folder must be listed and every listed file must exist with the stated size and hash; an unlisted file is an error.
[PROPOSED] 'catalog.file' appears in 'files'. 'catalog.serverCode' equals the ServerCode stored inside the catalog and the local machine identity.

[DECIDED 2026-10-05, Q2] Canonical form for signing, implemented by tools/Seal-Package.ps1 (PR #22): the manifest without 'signature' as compact JSON, object keys in ordinal order, arrays as stored (files sorted by path in ordinal order), every non-ASCII character as \uXXXX, integers as plain digits. For this manifest this is RFC 8785. [PENDING] owner approval with the trust bootstrap of the issuer public key: see contracts/credential-package.md, open questions Q1 and Q2.
[PROPOSED] The manifest is the file package-manifest.json at the package root and is not listed in 'files'. The seal log is kept outside the package.

[PROPOSED] 'builtAt' is the time of the last seal of the whole package. catalog_meta.built_at_utc is the time the catalog content was produced or last sealed after an edit; the two differ when only other files change. The application checks server_code and schema_version against the manifest, and that catalog.origin equals catalog_meta.source_kind, not the times.
[PENDING] Whether one package carries one catalog (one package per machine) or all catalogs with the application choosing by identity. This draft assumes one catalog per package.
